**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The fix is the right one-line idea: the Stock arm now pins `rev` unconditionally right after its `set_facets`, exactly mirroring the Model arm's M5.3 A pin (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs:652` vs `:630`). The pin lands paired with the facets it counts, which is what `model::set_rev`'s contract demands (`crates/app/src/model.rs:168-174`).
- No wire-grammar change, so no version bump is correct: `rev` was already serialized for every entity by `collect` (`crates/app/src/project/wire.rs:144`, `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "is_unrevised")]` on `EntityDto::rev`), so pinning to an absent key's 0 reproduces the pre-v20 fixed point exactly as the decision file claims.
- The stale comment in `wire.rs` is genuinely stale on main and the replacement is true.
- Decision file is in the right place with the right format (`docs/decisions/340-stock-rev-pin.md`); no `CHANGELOG.md` or `RECOMMENDED.md` edits; commit subject is conventional and the body ends `Fixes #340`; the body carries the `Changelog:` line.
- Prime Directive: nothing added uses `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`; `set_facets` keeps its saturating bump; the round-trip law gets stronger (byte-identical open-save-save), not weaker.

## Local results (trial merge with origin/main)

Merged cleanly onto current `main` - no conflicts, consistent with the note about staying clear of #341's hunks.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | builds |
| `project_roundtrip` (covers `app::project`) | 69 passed, 0 failed |
| `stock_stamp` / `stock_sim_document` / `stock_export` / `top_stock` / `drilling_cross_stock` | 4 / 9 / 2 / 4 / 8 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Negative check - I deleted the PR's Stock-arm hunk (test file kept) and re-ran the pinning test: it fails exactly as the issue describes, `"rev": 2` vs `"rev": 1`, proving the test pins the bug rather than riding the suite. Restoring the hunk returns it to green.

## Requested before merge

Nothing.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs` is now 746 lines. The ~400-line guidance says split along the domain seam rather than keep stacking; this PR adds 5 lines to an already-over file and stays clear of the loader's `EntityKind` arms' seam, which is fine for a corrective fix - just noting the file's growth for the next person who touches it.
- I re-ran the one suite the PR body flags as already red on main: `probe_op::every_older_kind_keeps_its_stored_id_and_digest_tag` fails in the merged tree (`assertion left == right failed: the probe arrives without a format rung`, `left: 52, right: 51` at `crates/app/tests/probe_op.rs:356`). That is the v52 rung from #344, untouched by this diff - the PR's honesty about it is appreciated, and it is not this PR's problem.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
